what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Nicaragua in all host countries combined: people who have asked for protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 269315 Nicaraguan asylum seekers, and Costa Rica hosts the largest share, 59.6%.
The United States is the next largest host.

why.text: The sources here don't say why people left Nicaragua: there are no dated events or armed conflicts for Nicaragua in them.
UNHCR's figures describe the scale of the movement, not its causes.

when.text: The number of Nicaraguan asylum seekers peaked at 356201 in 2024 and was 269315 at the end of 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, after big changes in most years from 2014 to 2022.

how.text: These are year-end totals of people whose claims had not yet been decided; refugees from Nicaragua are counted in a separate series.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
